baseline_models.mechanism: An affect located inside the containing scene becomes material stress: rage heats and distends the whole until separation is approached but not completed.

activation_trace.role: Near-action supplies an approached but incomplete threshold, keeping rupture imminent.
Cutting apart until the thing seems torn gives the threatened threshold its material failure mode.
Pent distress in the chest supplies internal pressure and personifies the container as an affected body.
Surging heat converts inward rage into a thermal force capable of stressing the container.

changed_reading.before: The place is described as extremely angry.
changed_reading.after: The place is an affected containing body whose pent, heated rage drives it repeatedly to the verge of self-rupture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ
baseline_models.mechanism: Passive deposit, cohort scale, custodial presence, and a recurring fixed question form an intake procedure: every arriving batch is contained and audited.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness and encompassment support the exhaustive force of every recurrence in the intake cycle.
Casting supplies involuntary transfer into the receiving enclosure.
A human cohort makes the unit of processing a batch rather than an isolated entrant.
Questioning and requesting supply the audit action performed on each cohort.
The keeper as one charged with preservation turns the speakers into custodial operators of the enclosure.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the single criterion tested by the custodial question.

changed_reading.before: Groups enter, and guards speak to them.
changed_reading.after: Each complete cohort triggers a repeatable custodial intake audit keyed to whether preventive warning reached it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah aligns two deliveries: the cohort is now forcibly cast into the destination, while the question asks about an earlier arrival of warning that could have altered that trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Forced casting defines the terminal delivery path.
The question explicitly compares terminal delivery with the availability of a prior intervention.
Coming and reaching define the preventive delivery path.
The caution-awakening warning is the payload whose earlier arrival is tested.

changed_reading.before: The keepers ask whether a warning messenger visited.
changed_reading.after: The question sets a missed preventive arrival against the cohort's now-unavoidable forced arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-tearing becomes one phase in a controlled pressure cycle: the wider creation is tested for fissure, inspection returns repeatedly, the enclosure draws a breath and boils, yet holding remains possible. The focus then marks a maintained rupture threshold rather than random collapse.

activation_trace.role: Approached action fixes the process at a repeatedly neared threshold.
Tearing apart supplies the pressure body's threatened structural failure.
Flaring heat turns rage into the internal energy of the cycle.
Audibly expressed rage allows the enclosure's sound to register its internal stress.
Opening and fissure provide the explicit structural failure whose absence elsewhere contrasts with the focus's near-tearing.
Return and repetition supply a cyclic frame for the later every-time sequence.
Drawing breath gives the enclosure a respiratory intake immediately before its rage is named.
Boiling and surging supply the fluid-pressure motion that drives the near-rupture.
Holding and confinement supply the counterforce that makes a sustained threshold conceivable rather than uncontrolled failure.

structural_cues: 67:3-4 couples a search for fissure with repeated inspection; 67:7-8 couples breath and boiling with near-tearing.
The modal near-action in 67:8 withholds completed rupture even while every cohort renews the load.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fissure, repeated return, inhaled breath, boiling, holding, and near-tearing; I supply the pressure-cycle arrow joining them. A live alternative is that these remain independent personifying and sensory images rather than one material process.

changed_reading.before: Rage simply makes the enclosure almost split.
changed_reading.after: Each intake renews a respiratory and boiling pressure cycle that is held at, and audibly advertises, the verge of rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The keepers' question is not a request for missing information. It opens a forensic sequence in which the cohort confirms arrival, identifies its own rejection, and reaches confession; the later pairing of concealed and public speech with knowledge of inward reality makes elicited self-disclosure the question's function.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the speech act that opens the evidentiary sequence.
Custodial keepers supply institutional speakers rather than curious bystanders.
The caution-awakening warning defines the fact on which testimony is elicited.
Actual coming supplies the cohort's affirmative answer to the keepers' arrival question.
Attributing falsehood identifies the cohort's own counteraction after warning arrived.
Admission that acknowledges and yields supplies the formal result of the interrogation.
Fault and guilt supply the content the speakers finally own.
Concealment in the interior shows that hidden speech is already within the field of knowledge.
Public declaration and raised voice complete the hidden-spoken contrast around disclosure.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower blocks an information-deficit account of the question.
Knowledge of the inward reality reinforces that the exchange exposes the entrants to themselves.

structural_cues: The question in 67:8 receives an explicit yes and account in 67:9-10, then becomes confession in 67:11.
67:13-14 expands knowledge across concealed speech, public speech, and inward reality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies question, confirmation, rejection, confession, and comprehensive inward knowledge; I infer that the question causes self-attestation rather than informing the keepers. A live alternative is a purely reproachful dialogue whose confession is sequential but not procedurally elicited.

changed_reading.before: The keepers ask for a fact they may not know.
changed_reading.after: The keepers administer a question whose function is to make each cohort state the already-known warning history and own its refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning-arrival separates into transmission, sensory receipt, comprehension or restraint, and inward uptake. The cohort admits that transmission succeeded, while listening and reasoning failed; later references to sending, hearing, inner faculties, and clear disclosure make the focus question an audit of an entire reception circuit.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching pose the question of successful delivery rather than mere dispatch.
Warning that should awaken caution is the circuit's input and intended behavioral output.
The question tests which stage, if any, failed.
The admitted coming establishes that physical and communicative arrival occurred.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies failed receptive uptake, not absent sound.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies the failed processing and behavioral brake.
Sending and dispatch establish transmission as a distinct stage from reception.
The recurring warning root keeps caution-awakening as the intended result of transmission.
The created hearing faculty supplies the sensory interface available to receive the warning.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies a site where received warning could become responsive judgment.
The speaker's warning role confirms the transmitted payload.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign marks the communication as made intelligible rather than merely sent.

structural_cues: 67:9 says the warner did come; 67:10 relocates failure to listening and reasoning.
67:23 names hearing and inward faculties, while 67:26 names a warning made clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, actual arrival, hearing, reasoning, inward faculty, and clear disclosure; I supply the staged signal-flow arrow and locate failure after delivery. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral capacities rather than a serial reception system.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only whether a messenger physically arrived.
changed_reading.after: The question audits whether a delivered warning traversed hearing, understanding, and inward restraint; arrival succeeded, but reception did not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus cohort can retain a social history rather than denote only a headcount. A mutually supporting force, a collective that recoils or mobilizes, and a gathering driven toward one destination are successively recoded as the batches cast into custody.

activation_trace.role: The human cohort anchors the reading in the focus ayah's batch unit.
Casting converts a formerly self-organized group into a passively directed load.
A mutually supporting troop supplies the imagined protective collective that precedes the focus cohort.
Recoiling and distancing supply the shared posture around which the cohort formed.
A mobilized supporting band keeps the collective image live within the aversion root.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies the conversion from dispersed people to arriving batches.

structural_cues: 67:20 imagines a protecting force, 67:21 describes persistent collective aversion, and 67:24 announces directed gathering.
The passive casting and singular cohort in 67:8 present the terminal form of that collective motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies troop, aversion or mobilized band, directed gathering, and cohort; I infer continuity of group identity through the sequence. A live alternative is that these are unrelated collective terms and each cohort is only a numerical batch.

changed_reading.before: A cohort is merely a quantity delivered at once.
changed_reading.after: Each cohort is a former formation of mutual support and shared refusal, stripped of agency and reassembled as a custodial batch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning first arrives as intelligible speech about a threatened future, then the promised object rushes into proximity and becomes seen. The retrospective question at intake therefore distinguishes the earlier arrival of a representation from the now-realized event into which the cohort has arrived.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching anchor the earlier arrival whose later realization is reconstructed.
A warning that reports danger and awakens caution is the event's earlier verbal form.
A threat-promise supplies the future object skeptically demanded before it becomes present.
Realization of promise by action supplies the transition from reported threat to fulfilled event.
The named warner keeps the preventive verbal stage explicit.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes the warning stage representational and intelligible.
Rushing into proximity supplies the warned event's conversion from future report to present encounter.
Calling for something identifies the realized object as what the challengers had verbally summoned or demanded.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks when the promised event will occur, 67:26 restates the clear warning role, and 67:27 makes the object near and visible.
67:8 looks backward from terminal arrival to ask whether preventive warning had arrived first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threatened promise, fulfillment, clear warning, demanded object, and sudden proximity; I infer a representational-to-realized-event transition. A live alternative is that the warning and the seen object remain merely successive topics without a shared arrival structure.

changed_reading.before: The question checks a past notification.
changed_reading.after: From inside the fulfilled threat, the cohort is asked whether its intelligible advance form had reached it before the event itself became near and unavoidable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مِنَ الغيظ strongly favors tearing from rage, while the mental-discrimination branch is secondary. It remains anchored in the packet's م ي ز branch and in the focus sequence of cohorts, questioning, and custodians, with reasoning, confession, and knowledge sharpening a classifier image. Render it only as a coexisting personification of the custodial complex, never as a replacement for material rupture.

activation_trace.role: A faculty that discriminates and infers meanings supplies the exploratory intelligence of the intake system.
Human cohorts supply the units to be distinguished and processed.
Questioning supplies the classifier's diagnostic operation.
Custodial keepers embody and administer the inferred discriminating function.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the faculty whose prior nonuse the intake distinguishes.
Confessional recognition supplies the classified result produced in the entrants' own speech.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supports an intelligent rather than merely mechanical intake image.

changed_reading.before: The enclosure nearly tears apart while guards separately question entrants.
changed_reading.after: Alongside rupture, the enclosure-custodian complex appears to discriminate cohorts by eliciting the failed reasoning each cohort must recognize.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because سأل is plainly a question here and the gentle-extraction image belongs to the packet's secondary س ل ل mapping. It remains worth carrying because the question is followed by admission and because custody, hiddenness, and the inward source of action form a visible extraction mechanism. Render it as a material analogy for elicitation, not as a lexical claim that سأل means سلّ in this construction.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently and covertly supplies the branch-distant material analogy for eliciting testimony.
Securing and concealing a thing supplies the interior store from which acknowledgment is figuratively drawn.
Confession that yields supplies the extracted object made explicit by the sequence.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden location from which speech is drawn.
The inward origin from which actions issue gives the extraction analogy a causal interior.

changed_reading.before: The keepers ask and the entrants later volunteer an answer.
changed_reading.after: The custodial question functions as an instrument that draws concealed acknowledgment out of the entrants' own inward store.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from warning speech to water supply and uses the water-channel branch of ء ت ي. It remains anchored by the repeated coming-to-you construction, the packet's explicit water-channel branch, and 67:30's sequence of sunken water, bringing, water, and spring. Render it only as an analogy of conveyance and life-enabling reception, not as an equation of the warner with water.

activation_trace.role: A channel that conveys water supplies the exploratory image of warning successfully routed to its addressees.
Caution-awakening warning is the potentially preserving content carried by the analogy.
Descent into inaccessible depth supplies the loss of an available source.
The repeated coming-to-you root directly activates conveyance through a water route in the closing question.
Supplying water by pouring gives the arrival a delivered-resource structure.
A flowing spring supplies the accessible source and continuing uptake that complete the analogy.

changed_reading.before: A warner either visited or did not visit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, warning is a preserving flow that was conveyed to the audience; the failure lay not in source or route but in refused uptake.

strongest_changes: Breath, boiling, fissure, repetition, and holding revise near-tearing into a controlled pressure cycle renewed by each intake.
The keepers' question becomes forensic self-disclosure: confirmation and rejection progress into confession despite comprehensive knowledge of inner speech.
Warning-arrival separates into dispatch, arrival, hearing, reasoning, inward uptake, and eventual realization; the failure occurs after delivery.
Cohorts can be read as former alliances and aversive formations gathered and recoded into passive custodial batches.
summary.what_was_special: Secondary branch activations made the custodial complex look discriminating, the question look extractive, and warning-delivery look like a routed flow; all remain contained analogies rather than replacements for the dominant syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the pressure-cycle model is a shared material mechanism or only a cluster of independent sensory personifications.
Whether the troop, aversion-band, gathering, and cohort vocabulary preserves social identity across the sequence.
Whether the discrimination, extraction, and water-flow branches can support downstream prose without overstating their form-distant status.
